policy.language: English-first, with selected multilingual official and specialist sources retained for local research.
policy.copyright: Store only headline metadata, a short plain-text excerpt, source attribution, and the original URL.
policy.selection: Prefer primary institutions and specialist additive-manufacturing publications. Keep standards, research, equipment, materials, software, post-processing, service, and application sources distinct. Label company-owned sources as official statements rather than independent reporting.
